svg.text: PLACEHOLDER: replace me with your drawing
When it is seen: return loss / VSWR measurement of a device (an input, an adapter, a
What to draw: the VNA with P1 connected, through a test lead, to the connector of the device
under test. The device is a generic box (the DUT) with a single connector.
Details: P2 not used; mark the calibration plane (the end of the test lead) with a dashed
vertical line or a mark, because the calibration is done there (open / short / load).
Save your drawing with this name (.svg, .png, .jpg or .webp). While this file is here, the program uses its own diagram.
